method: Read-only Mach-O bytes, nm, otool -arch arm64 -ov/-tvV; not Hopper decompilation
limitations: All facts are static; Objective-C selector calls do not establish a unique runtime receiver.
Assembly boundaries follow otool labels and are not verified complete function body ranges.
Literal argument recovery is deliberately conservative: reset on branches and caller-clobbered registers.
Only arm64 was disassembled. x86_64 remains inventory-level.
No native application execution, decompiler output, source-project recovery, or behavior equivalence is claimed.
